description: PL/SQL adds variables, choices and loops to Oracle SQL. It is used to work with data inside an Oracle database. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.
versionNote: Examples use Oracle Database 19c or later with SQL*Plus-style script commands.
whatYouWillLearn: Repeat while a rule is true with PL/SQL
learningObjectives: Use a named lookup with PL/SQL
